comments.body:
if you send out 20-30 emails or so i'd say you have decent chances of getting a couple of responses. 

points to include in the cold emails 
- academic background, skills and interests 
- relevant papers / projects at that lab 
- that you don't need to be paid but stipends are welcome (you're not allowed to be paid while doing a master's thesis afaik)
- that you'd love to talk or be connected to the right folks to talk to 

your best odds are with phds / profs who have some connection to eth, studied there or taught there previously in your field, so make sure to do your research and target the right people. 

you can pm me for a draft of the email, i just went through this process.
comments.author: aashnalize
